channel.title: DevOps Project Roles on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in DevOps Project Roles on KubeSphere

item.title: Create Project Role
item.description: This section describes how to create a project role. Prerequisites You need to join a DevOps project and have the Project Role Management permission in the project. For more information, see "DevOps Project Members" and "DevOps Project Roles". Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Project Role Management permissions and enter your workspace. Click DevOps > DevOps Project Management in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Project Role List
item.description: This section describes how to view the project role list. Prerequisites You need to join a DevOps project and have the Project Role View permission in the project. For more information, see "DevOps Project Members" and "DevOps Project Roles". Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Project Role View permissions and enter your workspace. Click DevOps > DevOps Project Management in the left navigation pane.

item.title: View Project Role Details
item.description: This section describes how to view project role details. Prerequisites You need to join a DevOps project and have the Project Role View permission in the project. For more information, see "DevOps Project Members" and "DevOps Project Roles". Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Project Role View permissions and enter your workspace. Click DevOps > DevOps Project Management in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit Project Role Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit project role information. You can edit the alias and description of project roles created by users. KubeSphere does not support editing built-in project roles, nor does it support editing the name of a project role. Prerequisites You need to join a DevOps project and have the Project Role Management permission in the project. For more information, see "DevOps Project Members" and "DevOps Project Roles".

item.title: Edit Project Role Permissions
item.description: This section describes how to edit project role permissions. You can only edit the permissions of user-created project roles. The permissions of built-in project roles cannot be edited. Prerequisites You need to join a DevOps project and have the Project Role Management permission in the project. For more information, see "DevOps Project Members" and "DevOps Project Roles". Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console with a user who has Project Role Management permissions and enter your workspace.

item.title: Delete Project Role
item.description: This section describes how to delete a project role. You can delete project roles created by users. Built-in project roles cannot be deleted. Prerequisites You need to join a DevOps project and have the Project Role Management permission in the project. For more information, see "DevOps Project Members" and "DevOps Project Roles". If the project role to be deleted has been assigned to project members, you need to delete the project member or modify their role.
